children: Soitec's photonics business growth trumps investor concerns that the French semiconductor-materials maker could lose market share in mobile communications, J.P. Morgan analysts write in a note to clients. They upgrade their rating on the stock to overweight from neutral. "While our prior concerns on market decline and share loss in mobile remain, these are overwhelmed by raised expectations for the silicon photonics business," analysts say. Earlier this month, Soitec lifted its revenue guidance for the current quarter as the race to build artificial-intelligence infrastructure continues to fuel demand for its products. Analysts estimate photonics revenue will exceed 1 billion euros in the fiscal year to the end of March 2030. Soitec shares trade 11% higher at 136.60 euros. (mauro.orru@wsj.com)
